candidate_program.name: dominance_gated_pressure
candidate_program.rationale: Scores isolates directly, relaxes count pressure when reward covers total blocker weight, and adds normalized excess-mass pressure otherwise. Reach is one weighted neighborhood; constant-size conditionals retain summary-update costs. The dominance threshold can change rankings abruptly.
candidate_program.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight / (1 + 0.5 * degree) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / (1 + degree + 0.2 * max(0, conflict_weight - weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
